profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft, where I build and lead developer tools that help engineers write, build, and ship software more effectively. I thrive on taking ambiguous problems and turning them into clear, impactful solutions.

I earned my B.S. in Computer Engineering from Virginia Tech with a 3.83 GPA and minors in Computer Science and Mathematics. I've worked up and down the stack, from low-level embedded and microcontroller programming to AI Agentic experiences.

I am most passionate when I am continuously learning — whether that's picking up a new technology, diving into an unfamiliar domain, or finding a better way to solve a problem I've seen before. I enjoy growing via being challenged and learning from others along the way!

Outside of work, I coach high school football, run half-marathons and Spartan races, and tinker with 3D printing and smart home projects

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Remote working for the C++ Cross Platform team in the Developer Division in Redmond, WA. Helping deliver products in C++ Agentic Experiences, CMake, Makefile, Linux, Embedded, and more for Visual Studio and VS Code.

Agentic Integrations for C++ developers in Visual Studio and CLI. 
● Developed agentic experiences that integrate build performance tooling and data from vcperf (Build Insights) analysis into agentic workflows, delivering 278+ minutes of build savings including individual wins of 40+ minutes.
● Improved agentic workflow reliability by up to 80% within CMake projects via a new C/C++ DevTools extension. 
● Iterate and prototype advancements and integrations of our agentic support in new surfaces such as Copilot CLI and GitHub Copilot entrypoints.

Technical Ownership
● Technical owner of Serial Monitor, CMake Tools, and Makefile Tools for Visual Studio and VS Code. 
   ● CMake Tools is an OSS VS Code extension with over 700K users and 50M+ downloads. 
   ● Regularly meet with Kitware, the developers of CMake, to align our products and continually support new features.

Test Reliability, Engineering Excellence, and Benchmarking
● Created test frameworks for our teams to enable benchmarking of agentic experiences within Visual Studio. 
● Own and continually improve a suite of automated CI/CD pipelines to ensure test and product reliability of features in both Visual Studio and VS Code.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Automated Test Workflows
● Created a brand-new AI-assisted Known Failures workflow to automatically triage test bugs and reduce engineer toil. 

Serial Monitor
● Designed and launched the Serial Monitor VS Code extension from scratch, enabling embedded developers to communicate with devices directly in VS Code — now supporting 30k+ users. 
● Partnered regularly with Xbox, ST, and NXP to guarantee device support in our VS Code embedded extension. 

CMake Tools
● Developed features such as integration of the CMake Debugger, optimizing performance for preset expansion/load. 
● Improve TextMate Grammars and text colorization support to better support developer experience.

CMake in Visual Studio
● Upgraded the "Targets View" for interacting with CMake targets to support pinning and interacting with CMake targets to more efficiently view, build, and edit CMake targets and files.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Contributed to C++ developer experience support in Visual Studio and VS Code for Embedded developers. 
● Assisted with the creation of a code generation system in order to share features between Visual Studio and VS Code.

company.name: Virginia Tech Bradley Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering

positions.title: ECE 2544 Undergraduate Learning Assistant (ULA)
positions.description: Assisted students taking ECE 2544 by leading office hours and helping students work through challenging course material. This experience helped develop skills in technical communication by breaking down complex engineering concepts for many different types of students.

positions.title: ECE Ambassador - Publicity Chair
positions.description: ECE Ambassador at Virginia Tech working to promote and improve the ECE Department at Virginia Tech.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
● Delivered features on the Visual Studio Cross-Platform team enabling C++ developers to more quickly set up required C++ development tools on remote Linux machines. 
● Gained experience with large-scale developer tooling, cross-platform build systems, and shipping features to millions of Visual Studio users.

positions.title: Software/System Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Delivered simulation capabilities for the Aegis Weapons System under an active Secret Security Clearance.
● Designed and tested new simulation tools alongside full-time engineers, contributing to critical defense system validation. 
● Gained experience in systems engineering, simulation design, and working within a classified environment on high-impact defense projects.

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description: Beginning in Summer/Fall 2018, I will mentor approximately 10 General Engineering students and assist them in acclimating to Virginia Tech and the difficulty of engineering at Virginia Tech.

company.name: Center of Engineering Education Diversity at Virginia Tech

positions.title: Computer Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on various projects for companies across the country and in these projects I worked with a lot of computer and electrical hardware. These projects spanned various applications, anywhere from 3D printers, to medical devices saving lives.

projects.title: Embedded Systems Design - Automatic Weight Delivery Rover
projects.description: An autonomous weight-collection rover. I implemented the sensor package which included a pixy cam for detecting targets and a combo of servo with IR sensor for obstacle detection.

projects.title: Drone Project
projects.description: Working with a team during class and more importantly, outside of class, my team created a drone prototype that we tested multiple times and once in a drone cage in order to evaluate our performance. I was the Leader of this team.

organizations.name: Baptist Christian Ministry (BCM)
organizations.description: Lead bible studies and help the family I am leading grow closer and create strong bonds to each other.
